_note: 安保叠加层（v0.9.6，card-omissions D3 / D7 / D14 / D15 / D16）：层级图上的地点 → 结界 / 监控 / 门禁 / 警报事实。只写卡里写明的规则，中性措辞；src = 出处条目。viewer 的 map/security.js 读，图层菜单「安保」开关（默认关）。

facts.text: 外层结界覆盖全岛，隔绝外部探查；以太驱动的结界发生器持续供能
facts.text_en: Outer barrier covers the whole island and blocks outside scrying; powered continuously by aether-driven generators

facts.text: 各房间另有隔音结界；F1 会客厅可一键启动
facts.text_en: Rooms have their own soundproof barriers; the F1 reception room can raise one at a switch

facts.text: 除主卧与书房外全覆盖；录像自动存档 30 日，重要内容永久保存
facts.text_en: Everywhere except the master bedroom and study; recordings kept 30 days, important ones permanently

facts.text: 实时画面投到大厅、书房、女仆长寝室三处屏幕；女仆长寝室的终端可调取监控
facts.text_en: Live feeds on screens in the hall, the study and the head maid's room; the head maid's terminal can pull recordings

facts.text: 门禁由植入的识别芯片控制：主人全域；女仆长除上锁的书房外全域；正式成员——个人寝室、F3 与 F1 公共区、B1 按当日任务；新进——新进寝区、F3 浴室、F1 大厅；B2 仅主人、女仆长与受押送人员
facts.text_en: Doors keyed to implanted ID chips: owner everywhere; head maid everywhere except the locked study; full members — own room, F3 and F1 common areas, B1 by the day's duty; newcomers — newcomer dorm, F3 bath, F1 hall; B2 only owner, head maid and escorted persons

facts.text: F1 会客厅有暗门通主人专用通道；F2 女仆长寝室有直通主卧的专用门（仅女仆长有权限）
facts.text_en: A hidden door in the F1 reception room leads to the owner's private passage; the head maid's room on F2 has a private door to the master bedroom (head maid only)

facts.text: 跨层通行：查验通行许可与身份芯片
facts.text_en: Cross-tier passage: permit and ID-chip check
